description: This is a test specification file for Playwright, specifically testing the behavior of skipping browser downloads during installation.

methods.name: test('should skip browser installs')
methods.description: A test to verify that the browser download is skipped when the PLAYWRIGHT_SKIP_BROWSER_DOWNLOAD environment variable is set.
